name: Jacob Hoppenstedt

projects.name: GatorCommunities (CanvasCommunities)
projects.description: Campus club discovery platform with ML recommendation engine using Jaccard similarity and EASE collaborative filtering. His most recent and most starred GitHub project.
projects.fun_fact: Uses actual machine learning to match students with clubs — not just a search bar!

projects.name: CelebMax
projects.description: Celebrity lookalike web app — upload a photo, AI matches against 25,000 celebrity images, then applies their hairstyle to your photo using HairFastGAN.
projects.fun_fact: Trained on 25,000 celebrities — your face in, famous hair out!

projects.name: Sweat Smart
projects.description: Workout planner mobile app that uses ChatGPT to personalize exercise routines. Cross-platform Flutter build.
projects.fun_fact: ChatGPT as your personal trainer — now THAT'S innovation!

projects.name: Profiteer
projects.description: Financial analytics platform visualizing spending history and savings goals with beautiful D3 charts. Led front-end improvements and Scrum ceremonies.
projects.fun_fact: Turns your messy spending into fancy charts — like a financial makeover show!

projects.name: Normal Weather
projects.description: Earthquake-preparedness survival game. Choice-driven gameplay with state machines, physics/collision, inventory, HUD. Optimized to improve FPS by 25%. Shipped for Web and desktop.
projects.fun_fact: A game about EARTHQUAKES called 'Normal Weather' — the irony is chef's kiss!

projects.name: ImHungry
projects.description: Recipe discovery app with 10,000+ recipes. Input your ingredients, get recipe suggestions sorted by rating or time.
projects.fun_fact: 10,000 recipes and STILL somehow hard to decide what to eat — relatable!

projects.name: AI & Classical Literary Texts (Published Chapter)
projects.description: Co-authored a chapter in a Taylor & Francis academic book about applying AI to classical literary texts. Published researcher as an undergrad!
projects.fun_fact: Most CS students just write code — Jacob got PUBLISHED in an actual academic book about AI and ancient literature. That's next level!

friends_and_collaborators: Daniel Dovale (Sweat Smart, CelebMax — frequent collaborator)

memorial.note: Jacob's beloved aunt Lisa Webb passed away in 2023. The tone goes: respectful pause → heartfelt words → 'Now let's raise a glass to Aunt Lisa! Take a shot for her!' This is important to the party host.
